title: not a great quality
text: not a great quality. I might have received a bad set, since everyone else seems to love those. They are not easy to clean, since cuts end up deep in the plastic and it colored badly after only a couple of weeks using them. They look like the old ones I tossed after 2 years., pretty gross already. I was hoping for a better sturdier quality, didn't work for me.
